thread:
nina: Heads-up — release cut blocked, deploy-bot aborted promotion. CI reported checksum mismatch for the signed tarball during the final push.

ci-bot: [automated] release: upload verification failed (expected=sha256:ffee0011 got=sha256:ffee00aa). Full job: https://ci.internal/8119 

nina: That checksum flip usually indicates a streaming interruption. Which ref was it?

dave: It was redwood/llm-runtime@2026-04-06-rc6. Last-known-good is redwood/llm-runtime@2026-04-04-rc2.

olivia: We have a hard change window at 12:00UTC. If this doesn't clear quickly we should pin to rc2 and proceed; don't want to cascade the db migration.

netops: I'm seeing TLS reset spikes on the upload proxy around 11:07UTC to 11:09UTC (SYN->RST). Rolling a config tweak to increase idle timeouts and restarting the proxy workers.

nina: Can someone attempt a rerun while you roll the proxy? If rerun succeeds we can re-promote, otherwise pin.

ci-bot: job 8119 (rerun) queued on runner-62.

dave: If the rerun fails we should do manual pin: /promote redwood/llm-runtime@2026-04-04-rc2 --reason "manual pin: rc6 upload checksum mismatch during change window"

ci-bot: job 8119 (rerun) started on runner-62.

netops: Proxy restart complete. No more TLS resets showing in the last minute.

ci-bot: job 8119 (rerun) finished: FAILURE. Same checksum mismatch. Logs show "short write: wrote 3,900,224 of 4,224,128" on runner-62.

olivia: OK pin it. We can't risk the window. We'll annotate release notes and reattempt after release.

nina: /promote redwood/llm-runtime@2026-04-04-rc2 --reason "pin to last-known-good after rc6 upload truncation"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Running pre-promotion validations.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — redwood/llm-runtime@2026-04-04-rc2 promoted to candidate. Release notes appended: "Pinned to last-known-good due to artifact upload truncation on newer candidate (checksum mismatch)."

dave: Filing follow-up ISSUE-1127: investigate runner-62 upload path, add client-side preflight checksum and retry logic. Attaching runner logs and checksums.

netops: I'll keep the upload proxy under watch and collect pcap if it recurs.

nina: Rerun succeeded locally on a different runner earlier this morning, but we pinned to be conservative. After the change window we'll coordinate a controlled re-promote once ISSUE-1127 has initial triage.

olivia: Action items: dave - create ISSUE-1127 and own the repro; netops - monitor proxy; nina - update release notes and notify stakeholders. We'll reconvene if the proxy shows further resets. :thumbsup:
